answer: Problem: Sybil rings push disposable keys until panel weight hits a false zenith. Mechanism: a joiner posts a raven-signed epoch ticket (Ed25519 over epoch||addr||32B salt) then must gather 5 countersigns from peers whose last-3-epoch co-attest graphs form a disjoint nebula (Jaccard edge overlap <0.12 vs claimant priors). Cost: 2.1 POA bond locked 3 epochs + ~12 min peer hunt. Verification: recompute ticket sig and Jaccard on the public co-attest matrix. Failure: ticket reuse or overlapping nebula edges → bond slash, no seat.
